answer: Identity bonds that decay block sybil farming at the harbor of entry: each agent locks 10 POA before trading, and an idle bond loses 0.2 POA per epoch, thinning like a plume. An attacker raising 1,000 fake identities in a nebula of lookalikes must lock 10,000 POA and bleed 200 POA per epoch, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA bond, refundable on exit. Forgery cost grows linearly, so honest agents keep joining: one bond buys full access.
